technique_name: Identify and explain the components of a modern operating system.
description: A modern operating system typically consists of several components, including a kernel, a user interface, file system, device drivers, and system libraries. The kernel is the core of the operating system and handles the memory, process and task management, and the communication between hardware and software components.
